title: Uk Mall World Realm
content: I’ve just recently come across this sub and it has really blown my mind! For years, since I was a child, I’ve been dreaming of “mall world”. I resonate with a lot of what American people have said about it, as well as certain aspects of maps posted. However, my world is a little different. I still have a highway (motorway), the highway is confusing, randomly cuts off and has those lights and blockades. Part of the highway goes to a huge industrial area with cargo ships. There’s a really big parking garage, it takes a while to pass through this so I try to avoid. Next to it is a castle?? May not even be a castle but the road is overshadowed by a huge brick wall, similar to a castle. Close to here is an underground entrance, it’s similar to a metro station (tube station) but it has shops in it, with metal shutters. If you were to look hard enough or map it out well enough you could get to the bigger mall upstairs. I haven’t been there much but just remember being lost, a sweet shop, a few clothing stores and a food area. I spend a lot of time in the “penthouse” or office building. The office building I only know the very top floor which has huge glass offices. The “Penthouse” is t even really a penthouse, I have an apartment in there, with a balcony. Every time I visit, my apartment is the same as before and in the same place. In these buildings there are lifts (elevators) that are pretty unreliable to be honest. I’d rather walk… if there were stairs. I’ve seen people talk about things being dirty or run down. I can’t say that I have noticed this. There is definitely a retro feeling and also an uneasy feeling with it being liminal spaces. Has anyone else ever experienced this version of a UK based mall world?
